Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human JAK3. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for JAK3 and organism for Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Sort by molecule ChEMBL identifier.
